name: asr_benchmark_store
description: A curated collection of automatic speech recognition (ASR) benchmark datasets gathered into a single store for easy evaluation and comparison of speech-to-text systems. It provides diverse recordings, languages and conditions so researchers can test robustness and generalization of ASR models across multiple real-world scenarios. The benchmark is intended to standardize evaluation and simplify aggregation of results across datasets.
reputation: A practical, aggregated repository of public ASR benchmarks with moderate adoption among speech researchers for evaluation and dataset access.
